position_overview: About the Role This is a growth role , not a posting role. We are not looking for someone who "manages social media." We are looking for someone who understands how content performs and grows . You will work directly with the team to turn podcast conversations into content test formats drive reach and engagement What You Will Be Responsible For 1. Content Repurposing Turn episodes into short-form clips (TikTok, IG, YouTube Shorts) Identify strong moments worth cutting 2. Platform Management Manage TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Ensure consistent posting and optimisation 3. Growth & Performance Track performance of content Identify what works and what doesn't Suggest improvements and new formats 4. Creative Direction (Execution-Level) Work on hooks, captions, and framing Test different styles and approaches What This Role Is NOT Not just scheduling posts Not generic Canva content Not passive execution Requirements Who This Is For We are looking for someone who: Has a proven track record growing social media accounts Understands short-form content deeply Knows what makes people stop scrolling Is proactive and brings ideas Can work closely and directly with the founder Location Philippines (preferred) How to Apply Send: 2-3 accounts you have grown (with metrics) 3 content ideas you would create from a podcast episode Benefits Remote working Work from anywhere At Substance , we're all about action, not just talk. If your profile aligns with what we need, you'll hear from us within 1-2 weeks. If not, no fluff-just know we value your interest and will keep you in mind for future roles where your skills can make an impact. We focus on real connections and meaningful matches, so when the right opportunity comes, we'll be ready to make it happen. Getsubstance.co Pte.
